# ABR BARAN Iran Server Optimizer (بهینه‌ساز سرور ایران — ابر باران)

> A free, open-source, single-file Bash tool that optimizes Linux servers located in Iran: it switches APT/DNF mirrors to fast Iranian mirrors, sets DNS, tunes kernel/network (BBR, sysctl), creates swap, installs essential tools, Docker, UFW and fail2ban, and hardens SSH, with progress bars and safety guides. Made by ABR BARAN IDC (abrbaranidc.ir). License: MIT.

Supported systems: Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux, CentOS, Fedora (bash 4.2+, run as root).

Install and run:

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrAbediii/abrbaran-iran-server-optimizer/main/abrbaran-optimizer.sh -o abrbaran-optimizer.sh && sudo bash abrbaran-optimizer.sh
